verdict.rationale: Archived docs describe per-user service tokens scoped to connections by `metadata.userId`, which would have matched this story. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, accounts and API keys stopped working on 2026-10-31, leaving only a public non-proxied registry. So the product no longer provides per-end-user connected accounts or scoped tokens.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can maintain separate connected accounts and scoped tokens per end user of my product, so each user's agent acts only on that user's credentials
